log.msg: Dawn, day 1. Snowbound Taiga. Always cold. Snow can be melted for water if you have fuel.
Somewhere to the south-east there is a town. Find it: its people know what this land is waiting for.
Your camp has a well. A cloak, a lantern and fuel are stored here: open Pack to take them.
A hard winter. Everything is colder, and storms come more often.
A vast world, 7 regions by 6: more land than one life can walk.
The key turns. Cold air comes up the stair.
You go down into the barrow. Level 1 of 3.
